$comment: The ONE place the mobile apps' target environment is described (owner decision 2026-11-19: one app, the hosted Portal, QA first then production). LT_APP_ENV picks it at build time (default qa); the app id and name are the same for both, only the Portal URL and the link host change. Read by capacitor.config.ts, scripts/app-env.mjs (iOS Environment.xcconfig, web/app-env.js), scripts/app-links.mjs and android/app/build.gradle. Nothing here is a secret.

appLinks.$comment: Universal Links / App Links. Filled by the owner once the Apple team and the signing keys exist (docs/mobile-release.md, owner checklist). Empty = scripts/app-links.mjs writes nothing, so no host claims the app by accident.
